claims: Generation Z is generally defined as those born between 1997 and 2012.
Generation Z is often referred to as digital natives.
Generation Z grew up with smartphones as standard technology.
Generation Z grew up with high-speed internet as standard technology.
As of 2025, Generation Z ranges in age from roughly 13 to 28 years old.
The most common range for Generation Z birth years is 1997–2012.
Some researchers or organizations use 1995–2010 as a range for Generation Z birth years.
Some researchers or organizations use 1996–2015 as a range for Generation Z birth years.
Generation Z is sometimes called Zoomers.
Generation Z is sometimes called Post-Millennials.
Generation Z is generally considered the first generation to have high-speed digital technology available from a young age.
The 1997–2012 span is the most widely cited by major researchers like the Pew Research Center
